target.title: HO-2369 Fix Discord component feedback edit path
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

HO-2369 found that Discord component accepted feedback can fail before plugin backend work starts. The Linear pipeline plugin acknowledges a component interaction, then calls `clearComponents({ text })` to clear/disable the original Start/Merge prompt. After `DeferredMessageUpdate`, Discord expects the original/source interaction response to be edited; the previous OpenClaw runtime wrapper used a post-defer `reply(...)` path instead, which can produce Discord `Invalid Form Body` and prevent the Start/Merge backend from running.

This PR updates the Discord monitor wrapper so acknowledged component `editMessage` / `clearComponents` uses `editReply(...)`, preserving the existing immediate pre-acknowledge `update(...)` path.

## Evidence

Local validation on this branch (`ecddbcc989`):

- `pnpm exec node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.extension-discord.config.ts extensions/discord/src/monitor/monitor.test.ts extensions/discord/src/internal/interactions.test.ts` -> 2 files / 35 tests passed
- `pnpm tsgo:extensions:test` -> pass
- `pnpm tsgo:extensions` -> pass

Regression coverage added:

- monitor-level test fails if `acknowledge()` + `clearComponents({ text })` calls post-defer `reply(...)` instead of `editReply(...)`.
- internal interaction test confirms component `DeferredMessageUpdate` is followed by PATCH to `/webhooks/<application_id>/<token>/messages/@original`.

## Runtime Note

Gateway/runtime reload is required after this lands. No gateway restart was performed by the agent.

## Related

- Plugin PR: https://github.com/hohsiang-lab/openclaw-plugin-linear-pipeline/pull/405
- Linear: HO-2369
